# AXON TECH Kenya — Premium Technology Hardware

> AXON TECH Kenya is a premium technology hardware retailer based in Nairobi, Kenya. We sell laptops, tablets, smartphones, audio devices, and accessories from our Axon brand and other premium manufacturers. We serve customers across East Africa with fast delivery and local warranty support.
